question: Classic pyrexia of unknown origin (PUO) is defined as fever lasting more than 1 week without diagnosis after 3 weeks of thorough inpatient investigation.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement swaps the two key thresholds. Classic PUO requires fever for more than 3 weeks and no diagnosis after 1 week of investigation — not the other way around. Remember: 3 weeks fever, 1 week workup.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct — this statement is false. The classic PUO definition (Petersdorf & Beeson, 1961) requires fever >38.3°C for more than 3 weeks (not 1 week) and no diagnosis after 1 week (not 3 weeks) of thorough inpatient investigation. The statement reverses these two thresholds — a common examination trap.
